# Vasudha Skin and Hair Clinic

Dermatology clinic in Muralinagar, Visakhapatnam, India, led by Dr. Vasudha Varada (M.B.B.S., M.D. Dermatology), Consultant Dermatologist & Cosmetologist. The clinic offers medical and cosmetic care for skin and hair concerns.

## Pages
- Home: clinic introduction, treatments overview, highlights, appointment request form.
- About: profile, education, experience, achievements and publications of Dr. Vasudha Varada.
- Services: treatments offered — acne and pimple treatment, hair fall and hair loss treatment, pigmentation and dark spots, chemical peels, anti-ageing and skin rejuvenation, PRP & GFC hair therapy, skin allergy and eczema care.
- Contact: clinic address, phone, email, Google Maps location and enquiry form.
- Book: online appointment request form.
